{"role_hierarchy": {"admin": ["user"]},
 "extra_transitions": [{"endpoint": "POST /orders/<int:oid>/cancel", "var": "Order.status", "from": "CREATED", "to": "CANCELLED"}],
 "cross_entity_invariants": [{"vars": ["Order.status", "Order.paid_amount"], "rule": "Order.status=PAID or SHIPPED implies Order.paid_amount equals the order total (greater than 0)"},
 {"vars": ["Order.status", "Order.status"], "rule": "SHIPPED implies the order was previously PAID (shipping only allowed from PAID state)"},
 {"vars": ["Order.user_id", "User.role"], "rule": "Only the owning user (Order.user_id equals current user id) may view, pay, ship, or cancel an order"}],
 "auth_chains": [{"endpoint": "POST /auth/login", "direction": "produce", "rationale": "returns a token, creating authentication state"},
 {"endpoint": "POST /auth/register", "direction": "produce", "rationale": "creates a user account with role=user, enabling subsequent login"},
 {"endpoint": "GET /auth/me", "direction": "require", "rationale": "observes id/username/role, requiring an authenticated identity from the token"},
 {"endpoint": "GET /orders/<int:oid>", "direction": "require", "rationale": "guard on Order.user_id equality enforces an authenticated, authorized caller"},
 {"endpoint": "POST /orders/<int:oid>/pay", "direction": "require", "rationale": "ownership guard requires authenticated current user"},
 {"endpoint": "POST /orders/<int:oid>/ship", "direction": "require", "rationale": "ownership guard requires authenticated current user"},
 {"endpoint": "POST /orders/<int:oid>/cancel", "direction": "require", "rationale": "ownership guard requires authenticated current user"},
 {"endpoint": "POST /admin/users/<int:uid>/role", "direction": "require", "rationale": "guard requires User.role equal to admin (role-based authorization)"}]}
